notes.title: Concordia: Digital Edition Salsa DLC is out!
notes.notes:
[h1]The long awaited first major DLC for Concordia: Digital Edition is now available for purchase! [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/ace1ce32219990cb0b05c28ed1f4c5063a536072.jpg[/img]
 
As of now you can access [b]Salt [/b]and [b]Forum [/b]modules, and [b]Hispania [/b]and [b]Byzantium[/b] maps on [b]iOS[/b], [b]Android[/b], [b]Steam[/b], and [b]GOG[/b]!

[b]Salt[/b] is a new kind of trading good that can not be bought or sold - it can only be acquired from Salt producing cities. It's also the most valuable of all the trading goods, as it can serve as any other good for the purposes of house construction or points scoring!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/0d91ee370eba5be96bfa58b32c3b4ecd4c70ebc9.png[/img]

[b]Forum [/b]is a mechanic bringing a whole new set of Forum Cards, where you get patricians and regular citizens to help you throughout the game. The bonuses they provide are either a one-time use powerful ability or an ongoing change to core game mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/30956dab5c2f60887dfd374f4412f7011e06a78e.png[/img]

[b]Hispania & Byzantium[/b] are the two maps that come with the [b]Salsa DLC[/b]. They don't bring any new mechanics by themselves, but the different layout in itself will significantly impact the gameplay and the tactics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/6bda6cb100f1ac2cea9273c71529f313963bcdd4.png[/img]

[h1]Last call for the tournament![/h1]

Don't forget you can still sign up for the [b]Concordia: Digital Edition Online Tournament![/b]
 
All you need is the base game of Concordia and the will to compete! The event is completely [b]free of charge[/b] and there are [b]real prizes to be won[/b] provided by us (Acram Digital) and PD-Verlag - the publisher of the tabletop Concordia! 

More information [b]here[/b].

[b]Hispania & Byzantium[/b] are the two maps that come with the Salsa DLC. They don't bring any new mechanics by themselves, but the different layout in itself will significantly impact the gameplay and the tactics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/6bda6cb100f1ac2cea9273c71529f313963bcdd4.png[/img]

[b]Salsa DLC[/b] has been in beta testing for a while now - both by the dedicated beta testers as well as the Season Pass owners who chose to try and err the beta content. 

And if you're excited about trying content early - you still can! [b]The Season Pass[/b] owners, regardless of platform, can always opt in and out of the beta content and try the DLCs mechanics and maps a bit ahead of time!

notes.title: Eight-Minute Empire Online Tournament
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29396969/bff9c81d7b595d9167ea2d517e2bb55a4f9861d1.jpg[/img]

Last year we organized a very successful (if I do say so myself) Online Tournament of Istanbul: Digital Edition. This year we'll give our other game a go. 

Ladies and gentlemen, nerds and nerdettes, we hereby invite you to take part in our Eight-Minute Empire Online Tournament! 

All you need to do is fill out the [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeg_BhCA5YzIIG-B1t4ZZTTjXhyU6i6sBctvJaxhEsyGuNEuw/viewform?usp=sf_link][b]participation form[/b][/url] and own the base game of Eight-Minute Empire on any platform. That's it!

notes.title: Official Statement
notes.notes:
Dear community,

As You may know, our Steam account has been suspended for an indefinite period of time. We are sincerely apologizing for that inconvenience and for the thing, that has been done by one of our members.  

We realize, that it was an unacceptable mistake. Many game developers know, how important the reviews are and how they affect whole Steam system. A failure of reviews sometimes would mean an end for independent companies. This matter is now discussed with Steam authorities in order to find any optimal solution.

Our team will keep working on games like Istanbul (which will be released in June on mobile devices like iOS/Android and we will do our best to release the game on PC/Mac/Linux as well) and improving our previous ones. We hope that our further actions will regain trust of players.

We are taking this situation very seriously, we have learnt a lesson and we are sorry for this.

At the same time, we would like to thank all players who support us.

We hereby inform you that  all our games, which were purchased on Steam, are still accessible through your Steam library.

Sincerely Yours,
Acram Digital

notes.title: Regarding Acram
notes.notes:
We've received a number of reports for Steam review manipulation on the titles Steam: Rails to Riches and Eight-Minute Empire, from Acram Digital. After investigating these reports we have found that the developer, Grzegorz Kubas, has been trying to inflate the user review score for his titles. This is against our policy, and something we take very seriously.

Because of Grzegorz's actions, we have removed all games/DLC developed by Acram from our store, and will no longer be doing business with him. Existing owners will be able to keep their titles.
